title: Fourier coefficient bounded by influence
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be monotone in the coordinatewise order. For any subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and coordinate $i\in S$, the absolute value of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ on $S$ is at most the influence of $f$ in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
